change: Specialized GDN recurrence, small dense GEMM, symmetric packed prefill GEMM, and fused gate/up/SiLU. FP16 boundaries, FP32 accumulators, batch 512 and model buffers retained.
notes: Local MLX measurement, not a published PrismML benchmark. Released shared rotations enabled.
Three trials; four warmup steps; 32 fixed decode steps with CPU token readback.
Rink chunks prefill at 512 tokens; MLX uses the whole prompt. MLX grows its caches; Rink reserves capacity.
All generated IDs match between matched baseline, new Rink and MLX trials.
256K is reserved capacity, not active history. No device allocations during prefill/decode.
Throughput varies across runs; earlier 512-token trials measured approximately 255 tok/s with the retained kernels.
